name: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 1.jpg|Melt the butter in the cake pan
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 2.jpg|Sprinkle the brown sugar over the butter
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 3.jpg|Top with the drained pineapple slices.
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 4.jpg|Fill in gaps with crushed drained pineapple.
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 5.jpg|Mix the flour, sugar, milk, egg, shortening, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 7.jpg|Stop blending when the batter is lemony-white.

File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 8.jpg|Pour the batter on top of pineapple/brown sugar in the pan. Put into oven at 350°F, and bake for 40–50 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out clean.
File:Pineapple upsidedown cake 9.jpg|Remove pan from oven. Immediately unmold cake by covering with a plate and flipping it over. Let cool before serving.
